svg.font-family: Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: Locksmith Internal Architecture & Resolution Flows
svg.desc: Shows the outer I/O boundary (CLI, Git driver, Node-API, opt-in registry) and the internal execution flows of crates/locksmith: YAML parsing with source-span tracking and duplicate-snapshot recovery, contextual merge with bounded preference flip-retry, scoped converge and pnpm migration, repair stabilization with evidence search and byte-for-byte fast path, read-only validate and inspect, and source-reusing verified YAML emission.

text.tspan: Thin I/O adapters around a pure in-memory Rust library — how merge, converge, repair, validate & inspect execute internally
OUTER I/O ADAPTERS (filesystem · Git · optional network)
IN-MEMORY BOUNDARY · ZERO I/O BELOW THIS LINE
crates/locksmith — Pure In-Memory Engine (model → yaml → peer → resolve → ops)
v9.0 project + pnpm 11–12 env doc · raw YAML byte spans
With final workspace context — resolve::resolve_sources (bounded flip-retry loop)
2B CONVERGE ENGINE (baseline + installed candidate → minimal edit diff)
Keep baseline pin if new range
2C REPAIR ENGINE (committed lock + workspace evidence → stabilization loop)
Any mismatch fails as an error
Core never guesses or performs network I/O. When merge, converge or repair lacks a version/release,
it returns exact RegistryRequest(s) (merge_with_requests batches independent ones) so the adapter fetches & retries.
Exit 0: verified YAML to stdout (Git driver overwrites OURS) · inspect report · silent validate.
Exit 1: Conflict, ResolutionRequired, UnmetPeers, or invalid lock (Git driver writes text merge to lock). Exit 2: I/O / format error.
